title: BlyaCut Agent Experience & Creative Workflows Contract
description: Authoritative contract for external AI editing agents operating on the BlyaCut Rust state core via MCP. Explicitly annotates every capability, permission, job feature, effect, and recovery mechanism with a 'status' field: 'implemented' (current BlyaCut 0.2 MVP) vs 'proposed' (future swarm design proposal).

mcp_tools_list.description: Native stdio MCP tools/list tool discovery over 2025-11-25 and 2025-06-18 lifecycle.

capabilities_list.description: Dedicated introspection endpoint returning detailed feature flags, limits, and supported plugin tiers.

independent_audio_tracks.description: Up to 64 independent audio clips across tracks.

audio_gain_and_fades.description: Linear gain (0..2000milli) and clip boundary fades (fade_in_ms, fade_out_ms).

proposal_diff_preview.description: Sidebar shows pending proposal clip counts and duration for user acceptance.

rich_visual_timeline_diff.description: Ghost clip overlays on timeline canvas rendering additions/deletions/fades.

recipe_v1_json.description: Safe JSON-only effect recipes with 7 fixed parameter steps, copied into project schema v3.

yaml_and_raw_filtergraphs.description: Arbitrary FFmpeg filtergraph strings or YAML manifests (not implemented; rejected by Rust validator).

sandboxed_wasm_dsp_and_wgsl.description: Wasmtime audio DSP and WebGPU WGSL fragment shaders.

inspect.name: get_project
inspect.description: Returns full immutable snapshot of current project and active integer revision.

inspect.name: get_session
inspect.description: Returns authorized media folder root, active background render job, and pending proposal.

inspect.name: list_effect_recipes
inspect.description: Loads valid Recipe v1 JSON files from the 'effects' subdirectory inside authorized root.

inspect.name: create_effect_recipe
inspect.description: Validates and saves a Recipe v1 JSON file into the authorized 'effects' folder.

inspect.name: preview_frame_at
inspect.description: Requests rendered preview thumbnail or frame metadata at a given timeline millisecond.

timeline_mutations.description: Appends an imported asset to the end of a video or audio track.
Splits a clip at an absolute timeline millisecond into two adjacent clips.
Modifies the half-open source interval [start_ms, end_ms) for a clip.
Moves an independent clip to an explicit millisecond position on a compatible track.
Changes the ordinal index of a video clip within the rippling video track.
Applies linear gain (0..2000 milli) and boundary fade in/out curves in milliseconds.
Removes a clip. Video deletion ripples subsequent video clips left; audio deletion leaves anchors intact. Requires propose_edits.

tier_1_recipe_v1_json.description: Portable data-only JSON recipes with 7 fixed parameter steps (brightness, contrast, saturation, hue, low_pass, high_pass, echo). Embedded/copied directly into project schema v3. Zero recompilation required.
tier_1_recipe_v1_json.execution: Built-in Rust core validator and FFmpeg filter mapping.

tier_1b_declarative_filtergraphs.description: Expanded arbitrary declarative filtergraph recipes with dynamic math expressions or YAML formats.

tier_2_sandboxed_wasm_shaders.description: Memory-bounded WebAssembly DSP audio processors and WGSL pixel shaders running in an isolated sub-process sandbox.
tier_2_sandboxed_wasm_shaders.execution: Proposed Wasmtime / WebGPU native runtime with hard memory limits (64MB) and no syscalls.

tier_3_sidecar_mcp_services.description: External local processes connected via Unix domain sockets for AI transcriptions (whisper.cpp) and stem separation.
tier_3_sidecar_mcp_services.execution: Proposed out-of-band background workers with progress streaming and JSON IPC.

allowed_root_enforcement.description: All input files and output parent directories must reside inside the user-selected folder.

canonicalization_and_symlinks.description: Paths are canonicalized via std::fs::canonicalize. Symlinks ARE allowed if and only if their canonical destination stays within the authorized root.

source_file_protection.description: Source media files cannot be deleted or overwritten by agent operations.

output_file_overwrite_protection.description: Output path must be an absolute .mp4 filename that does not currently exist.

tier_1_safe_mutations.condition: expected_revision matches active session revision exactly.

triggers: Batch contains 1 or more delete_clip operations
tier_2_destructive_proposals.approval_channel: Desktop GUI sidebar proposal card with Accept/Reject buttons.

tier_3_export_and_render.current_behavior: Currently starts directly over MCP if output_path is a fresh .mp4 file within authorized_root and expected_revision matches. Only one active render slot is permitted.

proposed_gui_modal_confirmation.description: Proposed future workflow where every export command pauses for explicit interactive human modal confirmation in the GUI before spawning FFmpeg.

revision_guard.description: Every mutation and export requires expected_revision integer.

string_error_on_stale_revision.description: On revision mismatch or validation failure, the Rust session returns a plain string error (e.g. 'Mismatched revision: expected 14, actual 15').

structured_http_409_payload.description: Proposed structured JSON payload: { error: 'STALE_REVISION', expected: 14, current: 15, divergence_summary: '...' }.

multi_agent_intent_leases.description: Proposed endpoint claim_track_intent where agents acquire timed leases on specific tracks to prevent cross-agent collisions.

export_video.description: Starts asynchronous background render of an immutable project snapshot to an absolute .mp4 destination.

cancel_export.description: Signals cancellation to the running render, terminates the FFmpeg child process, and removes temporary scratch segments.

job_polling.description: get_session returns the latest render job state, progress stages, and error string if failed.

retry_job.description: Re-submit a failed export job after resolving resource errors.

provenance_signatures.description: Cryptographic signature or structured JSON metadata comment embedding inside exported MP4 atom. Currently FFmpeg exports standard container metadata without agent signatures.

recipe_specification_v1.manifest_format: JSON only (YAML is not supported and is rejected)
recipe_specification_v1.storage: Project schema v3 stores full copies of effect recipes in project JSON

disallowed_steps.description: Arbitrary FFmpeg filter expressions, custom shell commands, JavaScript, and unvetted audio/video DSP are strictly prohibited by deny_unknown_fields validation.

raw_filtergraphs.description: Support for arbitrary FFmpeg complex filter graphs.

sandboxed_shaders.description: WGSL pixel shaders for GPU-accelerated video preview.

whole_project_snapshots.description: Rust core Editor stores up to 100 complete project snapshots in history. Undo/Redo swaps the entire project state and increments session revision.

inverse_edits_and_selective_undo.description: Proposed granular undo calculating inverse edit operations for a specific batch without rolling back subsequent unrelated manual edits.

schema_version.version_support: Project schema v2 is migrated on load. Project schema v3 embeds effect recipe copies.

atomic_commit_guarantee.description: Edits are applied to an isolated candidate project snapshot first. If validation fails, the project state and history are untouched, and a string error is returned.

scratch_cleanup_on_cancel.description: Temporary rendering segments in scratch directories are cleaned up on cancellation or error.

structured_conflict_recovery.description: Proposed automated 3-way merge or rebasing of agent edit proposals upon revision conflict.
